UnitStatement: This template is used for release-candidate notes and public release notes.
Bracketed placeholders in the template must be replaced before publication.
Unresolved decisions are kept as TBD with an owner or gate.
The Release Identity section records release label, source revision, release date, release authority, evidence profile, and artifact set.
Notes: Synthesized from Release Identity table field names; values are bracketed placeholders.

UnitStatement: The evidence profile field selects one of: skeleton, python, security, cargo, all, or custom.
The artifact set field selects among docs only, source archive, package candidates, installers, or TBD.
Release evidence describes software behavior, validation status, known limitations, and data-boundary controls.
The release evidence is not professional engineering approval, certification, sealing, endorsement, authentication, legal advice, or a code-compliance determination for reliance.
The Changed Surfaces section enumerates affected areas with a summary and supporting evidence per area.
Notes: Synthesized from table header; cell contents are placeholders.

UnitStatement: Tracked changed surfaces include Solver/mechanics, Rule engine, GUI/workflow, Reports/audit, API/interoperability, and Packaging/release.
Validation evidence records each gate with its command or record, result, and notes.
The release skeleton gate runs `python3 tools/release/check_release_readiness.py --profile skeleton --execute`.
The Python/schema contracts gate runs `python3 tools/release/check_release_readiness.py --profile python --execute`.
The security/privacy gate runs `python3 tools/release/check_release_readiness.py --profile security --execute`.
The Rust crates gate runs `python3 tools/release/check_release_readiness.py --profile cargo --execute`.
A protected-content review gate records a scan command or review record and its result.
Waivers must reference a human governance record.
Waivers must not authorize protected-content copying, private-data exposure, signing-secret exposure, professional approval claims, or code-compliance claims.
The Known Limitations And Open Risks section lists limitations or risks and any TBD decisions with owners.
Notes: Section body is bracketed placeholders; statement describes the section's required content.

UnitStatement: Public artifacts do not intentionally include protected standards text, protected tables, protected examples, proprietary commercial data, private project data, private rule packs, private material/component libraries, or real secrets.
Public examples and fixtures must be classified as invented, public-domain, permissively licensed, not applicable, or TBD.
Telemetry and external data transfer status must be recorded as off by default, not applicable, or TBD.
OpenPipeStress is decision-support software.
OpenPipeStress may compute mechanics, evaluate user-supplied rule packs, record diagnostics, and assemble auditable reports.
Competent human review remains required before professional reliance on any project-specific piping calculation.
The Reproducibility Manifest records git revision, working tree state, Python version, Rust/Cargo version, Node/package tooling version, host OS, commands run, and artifact checksums.
Notes: Synthesized from manifest field names; values are placeholders.

UnitStatement: The Upgrade And Compatibility Notes section records migration steps, compatibility breaks, schema version changes, or none.
Notes: Section body is a bracketed placeholder.

UnitStatement: The Human Review Record captures dispositions for release authority, data-boundary review, professional-boundary review, and known-risk acceptance.
